description: This CSS file contains theme management variables and styles for the App component in the tic-tac-toe frontend. It defines light and dark theme color variables and includes styles for elements such as the App header, logo, and theme toggle button.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application container with styles for layout and color based on the theme.

classes.name: App-logo
classes.description: Styles for the application logo including animations and layout.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Styles for the header section of the application including layout and color.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Styles for links within the application, including theme-based color.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Styles for the theme toggle button, including position, color, and hover effects.
